name: Hotel Kögele
beschreibung: Hotel Kögele is situated in Lermoos within the scenic Tiroler Zugspitz Arena. Framed by the iconic Zugspitze and the Wetterstein mountain range, the hotel provides a tranquil alpine base. In winter, guests enjoy effortless access to the slopes of the Zugspitz Arena, while summer reveals extensive scenic hiking paths. Accommodations include a heated indoor pool, a restorative sauna area, traditional alpine rooms, and a restaurant serving regional culinary classics.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Kögele in Lermoos in the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena features an indoor swimming pool, a sauna area, alpine rooms, and direct access to slopes facing the Zugspitze.
